endSession.title: End session {{id}}?
endSession.body: The unit stops streaming and the technician at it is disconnected. The session record stays in the ledger.

deleteDevice.title: Delete unit {{name}}?
deleteDevice.body: Its metrics history, alerts, sessions and queued patch deployments are deleted. This cannot be undone.

deleteUser.title: Delete user {{name}}?
deleteUser.body: Their sign-in stops working at once. Alerts they signed off keep their name in the ledger. This cannot be undone.

deleteWebhook.title: Delete webhook {{name}}?
deleteWebhook.body: Matching events stop being delivered. Deliveries already sent are not recalled.

deleteSsoBinding.title: Delete the {{name}} binding?
deleteSsoBinding.body: The provider stops mapping to a console account, so anyone signing in through it is bounced back to the login screen.

deletePolicy.title: Delete policy {{name}}?
deletePolicy.body: Queued deployments for it are dropped. Patches already installed on units stay installed.

purgeMetrics.title: Delete all metrics history and alerts?
purgeMetrics.body: Every stored sample, chart history and alert record is deleted. Units keep reporting — the history is what goes. This cannot be undone.

deleteAccount.title: Permanently delete your account?
deleteAccount.body: Your sign-in, API keys and webhooks are deleted. Units and their records stay on the server. This cannot be undone.

deleteApiKey.title: Delete API key {{name}}?
deleteApiKey.body: Scripts using it stop working at once, and the record leaves this list.

revokeApiKey.title: Revoke API key {{name}}?
revokeApiKey.body: The key stops working at once. Its record stays here, so the rotation is visible.

deleteClient.title: Delete {{name}}?
deleteClient.body: Its {{units}} units stay, unassigned. Nothing is deleted and no unit stops reporting. Technicians granted only this client see an empty fleet on their next request. This cannot be undone.

revokeToken.title: Revoke “{{name}}”?
revokeToken.body: Units already enrolled keep reporting and stay in {{client}}. An agent presenting this token is refused, and the token cannot be shown again — the server stores only its hash.

clients.assignHint_one: {{count}} unit will be in this client.
clients.assignHint_other: {{count}} units will be in this client.
clients.accessHint: A revoked technician loses this fleet on their next request, no logout.
clients.tokensEmpty: No enrollment tokens. A unit enrolled with the installation secret joins unassigned.
clients.tokensRevealHint: Shown once. The server keeps only its hash, so it cannot be shown again.

clients.disabledTitle: This tenant is paused: it is not offered for assignment, and its units keep their history.

audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: who did what, to which tenant, and what the server answered
audit.noAccess: The audit log is an operator surface: administrators read the installation, managers read their clients.
audit.retention: Records older than {{days}} days are removed
audit.sweepNever: The retention sweep has not run yet on this server
audit.sweepFailed: The last retention sweep failed — records are being kept past the window
audit.empty: Nothing in the log for this filter. Records older than the retention window are gone.
audit.footnote: Refused attempts are recorded too — that is what the log is for. Rows older than {{days}} days are pruned.
